name: palette
title: Command palette
description: One quick pick for files, commands (>), go to line (:) and colour themes, plus the Settings and Keyboard Shortcuts pages.
note: Built into Forge: forge.screen.json includes palette.json, and its natives (if any) are compiled in, so this manifest names and versions the package and lists no provides; it is not in the catalogue. Its file provider reads the index the native forge.index makes (FileIndex.cpp).
